data.body_html:
Experience the thrill of spotting wild dolphins off the Costa del Sol on a dolphin watching brunch cruise in Marbella 2039. Departing from Puerto Banús, this private charter combines wildlife viewing with a relaxed brunch on the water. Choose a 2-hour brunch cruise from €749 or an 8-hour full-day trip from €2,299 – both include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and light snacks. With bottlenose and common dolphins frequenting the waters between Marbella and Estepona, sightings are common year-round. Book your spot for a morning of adventure and Mediterranean luxury.

Why Choose a Dolphin Watching Brunch Cruise in Marbella?

Marbella’s coastline offers some of the best dolphin-watching opportunities in southern Spain. The warm, nutrient-rich waters of the Alboran Sea attract pods of dolphins, often sighted within 15–30 minutes of departure from Puerto Banús. A private brunch cruise means you avoid crowded tour boats – it’s just your group, the captain, and the sea. The Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39) are perfect for small groups, with spacious decks, a shaded saloon, and a sound system for music. Brunch includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks – all included in the price. No hidden fees, no extra charges.

What to Expect on Your Dolphin Watching Cruise

Your skipper will head west towards Cabopino or east towards Cala del Faro, areas known for dolphin activity. The boat cruises at a leisurely speed (8–12 knots) to minimise disturbance. Dolphins often approach the bow, riding the wake – a magical sight. The 2-hour brunch cruise is ideal for a quick escape; the 8-hour full-day option adds swimming stops, coastal exploration, and time to sunbathe. All charters include safety briefings and life jackets. The experience is fully private – no other guests join your boat.

  • Duration options: 2 hours (€749) or 8 hours (€2,299)
  • Boats: Astondoa 40 (9 pax) or Azimut 39 (11 pax)
  • Inclusions: Skipper, fuel, brunch, drinks, insurance, VAT
  • Departure: Puerto Banús, Marbella

The Brunch Menu – What’s Served Onboard

Your brunch cruise includes a selection of drinks and light snacks served throughout the trip. The standard menu features bottled water, soft drinks (Coca-Cola, Sprite, orange juice), beer (Mahou or similar), white wine (Verdejo or Albariño), and cava. Light snacks include olives, crisps, nuts, and finger sandwiches. For a premium upgrade, contact us via WhatsApp to arrange a custom menu – options include seafood platters, Spanish tapas, or champagne. The drinks are served chilled in the boat’s fridge, and the crew will refresh supplies as needed.

Best Time of Year for Dolphin Watching in Marbella

Dolphins are present off the Costa del Sol year-round, but the best months are May through October. During this period, sea temperatures range from 18°C to 26°C, and calm seas make spotting easier. Morning departures (9:00–11:00) offer the highest chance of sightings, as dolphins feed actively after dawn. Winter months (November–April) still see regular pods, but conditions can be choppier. Our captains monitor local conditions and will advise on the best departure time for your booking.

Which Boat Should You Choose for Your Brunch Cruise?

For the dolphin watching brunch cruise, we recommend our Tier A boats:

Both boats offer comfortable seating, sun pads, and a shaded cabin. If you have a larger group (up to 12 guests), consider the Mangusta 80 (24m, €4,719 minimum 4h) which includes a jet ski. For smaller groups, the Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) is available on request. Browse our full fleet for more options.

Where to Spot Dolphins Near Marbella

Dolphin hotspots include the waters off Cabopino (east of Marbella), Cala del Faro (near Estepona), and the Punta de la Mona area. The skipper will navigate to areas where dolphins are frequently seen, using local knowledge and radio reports. Bottlenose dolphins are the most common species, but you may also see striped dolphins, common dolphins, and occasionally pilot whales. The trip typically covers 10–20 nautical miles, offering views of the Sierra Blanca mountains and La Concha peak in the background.

How to Book Your Dolphin Watching Brunch Cruise

Booking is simple. Visit our Boat Rental Marbella page, select the dolphin watching experience, choose your boat, date, and duration. A 50% deposit secures your booking via bank transfer or card. The balance is due 48 hours before departure. Contact us on WhatsApp for last-minute availability or custom requests. All prices include 21% Spanish VAT – no surprises. We recommend booking at least 3–5 days in advance, especially during peak season (June–September).
